messages:
Bea: Tiny holiday idea : Snowman Sock Swap + Desk Buddy Photo corner. Bring a mismatched/ugly/funny sock (clean) to swap, OR drop a small desk-snowman (pom-pom or paper) by Fri noon. :snowman::socks:

Omar: This feels like certified chaos. I love it. How does the swap work? Do we just take one and leave one?

Bea: Yep, anonymous swap box on the kitchen counter labeled "Sock Snow Swap". Leave one, take one. If remote, mail one to the office and @Omar will accept packages.

Sasha: Can we also do a quick desk-photo contest? Best tiny snowman on a desk wins a goofy prize. Remote folks can DM photos and Ill post a collage.

Devon: I will donate a novelty snowman cookie cutter as a prize. Small and excessive. :cookie::snowflake:

Ruth: Shipping note for remote folks: please put socks in a small padded envelope and mark it "Sock Swap - Ruth" so mail volunteers know where to put them. Avoid heavy stuff.

Nick: Question: are novelty socks allowed? I have LED-lit socks that flash. Probably a hazard?

Bea: LED socks are allowed if battery removed. No open flames, no perishable goodies, please. Keep it desk-safe.

tinsel-bot: Reminder: Sock drop-off closes Fri 12:00 PM. Desk Buddy Photo submissions due Fri 5:00 PM. Post collage Sat morning.

Omar: I can pick up mail Thursday and label things into the box. DM me tracking if you ship. Ill quarantine anything suspicious.

Sasha: Collage plan: send photos to me via DM or upload to \#files/snow-swap-2025 with filenames like name-city.jpg. Ill compile and tag winners by reaction votes.

Devon: Tiny rule suggestion: if you take a sock you must wear it at least once to celebrate the swap. Honor system. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

Ruth: Also adding a "Best Tiny Snowman Story" prompt if anyone wants to write a one-line origin tale to go with their desk buddy. Could be ridiculous.

Nick: Photo uploaded (teaser): https://img.redwood/team/sockteaser.jpg - my sock is suspiciously festive.

Sasha: Love it. Remote photo DM received from @Lena in Berlin : she made a tiny snowman out of origami and a paper coffee sleeve. So creative.

Bea: Prize categories: "Most Ridiculous Sock", "Cutest Desk Buddy", "Best Tiny Snowman Story". Winners get a small mug + cocoa packet + mystery sticker.

Omar: Logistics: if you ship internationally, ping me first so I can give you the consolidated office address (helps avoid multiple partial shipments).

Ruth: Safety PSA: please avoid glitter if you can. It gets everywhere and will haunt desks for months. Sequins ok in small qty.

Nick: Will someone on-site take a pic of the box after drop-off so remote people can see the pile?

Bea: Yes, Ill snap a picture at 12:05 Fri and post it here. Also adding a tiny QR code to the box linking to the photo upload instructions.

tinsel-bot: Event created: Snowman Sock Swap drop-off window Fri 12:00 PM; Photo collage Sat 9:00 AM. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood/events/snow-sock-2025

Sasha: Thank you all for low-effort merriment. Cant wait to see who brings the sock with a tiny scarf. :sparkles:

Bea: Thanks team! Small, silly, and optional  exactly how holiday threads should be. Happy tiny-holidaying. :sparkling_heart:
